description: Run due (past-due pending) Action Scheduler actions now through Action Scheduler's own runner, oldest first. Optional hook/group filters. Returns processed, failed, remaining. 501 when Action Scheduler is not active. Audit-logged. cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.16.0+.

batch_size.description: How many due actions to run (1-50, default 25)
